priorityList: Summon your pet (or use Grimoire of Sacrifice) and pre-cast Soul Fire before combat starts.
Use Soul Fire on cooldown if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Chaos Bolt if Demonic Art is active or if your Diabolic Ritual duration is shorter than the Chaos Bolt cast time.
Use Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no Backdraft stacks.
Use Summon Infernal and Malevolence on cooldown.
Use Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you have room for shards (under 4.6).
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if you have the Fiendish Cruelty buff active.
Maintain Wither (or Immolate) on your target; refresh if it has less than 5 seconds remaining or before a Chaos Bolt cast if using Internal Combustion.
Cast Ruination as soon as it is available.
Use Cataclysm on cooldown, especially if Lake of Fire is talented.
Cast Chaos Bolt to spend shards if you have 4+ Soul Shards, or during Malevolence or Summon Infernal windows.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Use combat potions and DPS trinkets while Summon Infernal is active.
Cast Incinerate as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards.
